name: Yamatotakada (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Yamatotakada city emblem in white: a pointed arch enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Yamatotakada, a city in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 October 1982; the emblem dates from 1932.

features.role: Yamatotakada city emblem — a pointed arch enclosing a stylised character
